evidence: Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and modifies private broadcast tracking and net processing in src/private_broadcast.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Retaining finished private broadcast transactions provides operator visibility into send history and network echoes without altering core relay or origin privacy protocols. The PR description notes that 'this allows the inspection of when and to whom the transaction was sent as well as when/if it was echoed from the network.'
